title: The Squatters' Flotilla
logline: A makeshift orbital settlement of evicted refinery families is towed toward a solar radiation flare by corporate security tugs, hiring an armed pilot to cut the lines.

roles.description: Represents two hundred evicted smelter workers living inside chained freight containers; fierce, sleep-deprived, guarding children.
Captains the heavy corporate salvage tug; cold, disciplined, treating human settlement clusters as orbital hazards.
A reinforced industrial tug equipped with heavy magnetic winches and high-output cutting lasers.
The corporate extraction syndicate that evicted the workers after automating their refinery modules.
A jury-rigged habitat of fifty pressurized cargo containers lashed together with heavy towing cables.
An independent scrapper haven outside corporate jurisdiction willing to grant temporary berthing.

public_situation: Corporate tugs attach magnetic grapples to {role:squatter_cluster}, claiming the container settlement poses an uncertified navigation hazard.
private_truth: {role:refinery_consortium} programmed the towing vector directly through an unshielded solar flare zone to incinerate the settlement and avoid paying severance.

beats.public_change: Alarms wail inside the lashed cargo pods as magnetic towing winches engage, dragging the cluster outward.

missions.reason: She needs emergency life-support scrubber filter cartridges rushed into the cluster through the external airlock before the pods lose pressure.
missions.private_fact: The consortium cut the cluster's auxiliary umbilical line thirty minutes before attaching the tow clamps.

beats.public_change: Telemetry scans reveal the tug's trajectory intersects a severe coronal magnetic flare loop in forty minutes.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to scan the tug's guidance beacon and broadcast the lethal trajectory telemetry to public station radios.
missions.private_fact: Her eldest daughter is among the mechanics locked inside the pod maintenance hub trying to manually cut the cables.

beats.public_change: {role:repo_tug} accelerates thrusters into the flare vector, ignoring emergency hails from the container community.

missions.reason: She needs the tug's winch nacelles disabled before the cluster enters the fatal radiation boundary.
missions.private_fact: The tug skipper hails mid-fight offering sixty thousand credits in mineral vouchers to escort the tug through the scrapper lines.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the tug and severs the towing lines.
resolutions.summary: The tow cables are severed in time. The container flotilla is towed to {role:free_port_dock}, and {role:refinery_consortium}'s lethal eviction is exposed.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary shot the winches off a corporate tug that was dragging two hundred evicted families into a solar flare.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the skipper's payout and lets the tow continue.
resolutions.summary: The tow continues into the outer flare boundary. The containers suffer fatal decompression, and {role:refinery_consortium} closes the ledger on all back-pay claims.

consequences.public_summary: Dark rumours persist of a hired pilot who took corporate scrip to look away while an evicted container colony drifted into the fire.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or abandons the contract before the flare strike.
resolutions.summary: The container pods cross the solar radiation threshold. Life support fails across all units, and the consortium lists the incident as an accidental navigation loss.

loose_threads.detail: The autopilot memory on {role:repo_tug} shows the flare vector was pre-calculated and uploaded three weeks before the eviction was announced.
The consortium's payroll ledger lists five million credits in severance escrow scheduled to revert to company reserves if the workers cease claiming berths.
The hazard eviction decree posted on the dock is authenticated with an expired notary serial belonging to an attorney who died two years ago.

radio_hooks: Port control warns civilian traffic to avoid uncertified squatter container clusters.
{role:refinery_consortium} declares automated smelting operations are achieving record efficiency.
Refugee advocates protest hazardous drift towing outside {role:free_port_dock}.

voice_direction.flotilla_delegate: Raspy, raw, and trembling with fury. Delivers curt, desperate commands over blaring hull decompression alarms.
voice_direction.security_skipper: Monotone, clinical, and totally remorseless. Treats two hundred living people as generic 'derelict freight mass' requiring routine orbital clearance.
